# intenter uninstall claude

Remove Intenter's hooks and stop the daemon

Removes only the hook entries Intenter installed (including any left by a
pre-rename development install), backing up the settings first, then stops
and unregisters the daemon and the terminal update check. Your approvals,
history and configuration are kept unless you pass --purge. Claude Code
keeps working exactly as before Intenter was installed.

## Usage

```text
intenter uninstall claude [flags]
```

## Examples

```console
intenter uninstall claude
intenter uninstall claude --purge
```

## Options

| Flag | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--keep-daemon` | — | leave the daemon running and registered |
| `--purge` | — | also remove the approvals, history and configuration |
| `--settings` `<string>` | — | override the Claude settings file |

## Options inherited from parent commands

| Flag | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--config` `<string>` | — | override the configuration file path |
| `--data-dir` `<string>` | — | override the Intenter data directory |
| `--json` | — | machine-readable JSON output |
